blocks.title: Crystal lattice
blocks.text: Three-dimensional (3D) space mein ions, atoms ya molecules ke regular (ba-qaida) arrangement ko crystal lattice kehte hain.
Jin solids ki shakal fixed, regular aur three-dimensional geometric ho, unhen crystalline solids kehte hain. Misalein: heera (diamond), sodium chloride (namak), barf (ice) waghera.
Properties of crystalline solids (crystalline solids ki properties)

Har crystalline solid ki ek fixed aur pehchanne wali geometrical shakal hoti hai, kyunke us ke atoms, ions ya molecules 3D jagah mein definite aur orderly tareeqe se lage hote hain. Kisi crystal ke faces (chehron) ke darmiyan interfacial angles (zawiye) hamesha ek jaise rehte hain, chahe crystal kisi bhi size ya shakal mein ugaya jaye. Crystal ko pees kar bareek powder bana dein, tab bhi us ke faces aur angles wahi rehte hain.
Crystalline solids ek sharp (bilkul fixed) temperature par pighalte hain. Isi melting point se unhen pehchana ja sakta hai.

Crystalline solid tootta hai to hamesha definite planes (satahon) ke saath tootta hai. Inhen cleavage planes kehte hain. Kisi ek solid ke liye yeh planes ek doosre se ek khas angle par hoti hain, aur yeh angle har solid ka apna hota hai.
iv. Growing of a crystal (crystal ugana)

Kisi crystalline cheez ka suitable solvent mein saturated ya supersaturated solution (jis mein had se zyada cheez ghuli ho) ho, to us ke atoms, ions ya molecules arrange ho kar usi type ke crystals bana dete hain. Ise growth of crystals kehte hain. Yeh solvent ko aahista aahista evaporate kar ke ya saturated solution mein chhota crystal dal kar (seeding) kiya jata hai.

Misal: sodium thiosulphate (Na₂S₂O₃) ki pani mein solubility 100 °C par 231 g/100 cm³ aur room temperature par 50 g/100 cm³ hai. 100 °C par saturated solution ko aahista thanda karein to crystal nahi bante; yeh supersaturated solution solid ke saath equilibrium mein nahi hota. Ab is mein Na₂S₂O₃ ka ek chhota crystal dal dein to crystallization foran tezi se ho jati hai.
v. Habit of a crystal (crystal ki khas shakal)

blocks.title: Habit of a crystal
blocks.text: Crystal jis shakal mein aam taur par ugta hai, use us crystal ki habit kehte hain.

Agar crystal ugane ki conditions (shartein) wahi rakhi jayein to crystal ki shakal hamesha wahi rehti hai. Conditions badlein to shakal badal sakti hai. Maslan NaCl ka cube (dabba numa) jaisa crystal, solution mein 10% urea impurity (milawat) ke taur par ho to needle (sui) jaisa ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Seed crystal ek template (saancha) ka kaam karta hai: supersaturated solution ke extra particles ko jurne ke liye ek regular surface mil jati hai, is liye crystallization foran shuru ho jati hai.

items: Crystal lattice: particles ka regular 3D arrangement; crystalline solids (heera, NaCl, barf).

Properties: fixed geometrical shakal aur interfacial angles, sharp melting point, cleavage planes, saturated/supersaturated solution se crystal growth (Na₂S₂O₃: 100 °C par 231 g, room temperature par 50 g fi 100 cm³), aur habit (NaCl ka cube 10% urea se needle jaisa).
